## Hypothesis

Gap-up openings above VWAP into a bearish ribbon (EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50) tend to fade, offering short entries. The edge comes from mean reversion after excessive bullish opening gaps when intermediate-term momentum is already bearish, creating a high-probability fade setup during early morning hours.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the open gaps up >0.4%, the opening price is above VWAP, and the ribbon is bearish (EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50), enter short at the first bar that closes below VWAP.  
Exit: Stop above the gap high; target 1R or trail using a premium-stop % exit (to be defined in params.json). Regime hints: VIX >15, time between 09:30-11:30, avoid strong up-trend days (ADX >30).
